model.options_note: 3 options of the same scene, different camera, moment or framing. The first is the most literal.

default.label: Default
default.description: The original Design Lab moodboard. Used when a request doesn't name another one.
default.references_note: Every reference is sent with every generation, in slot order.

rules.no_text_in_images: No text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks. Words on a design come from its template.
rules.faithful_to_request: Keep the person's subject, action and setting. Add nothing they didn't ask for.
rules.describe_scene_not_style: The style's references set the look; prompts describe only the scene.
rules.never_with_mascot: The mascot and realistic imagery are never combined (routing handoff, 2026-10-23).
